question: Upgrade to 0.2.15-nvfp4.7, and which drafter for the OrcaRouter ModelOpt pack: the MTP as before, the MTP with Basalt's drafting (own or Basalt's draft layer), or DFlash2?
decision: Production runs 0.2.15-nvfp4.7 (engine 0.1.61) with the MTP and Basalt's drafting over Basalt's self-distilled draft layer (mtp/rt-tuned, --spec 8 --mtp-head proxy --mtp-cum auto, "drafting": "mtp"), upgraded in place on 2026-11-23.
method: scripts/benchmark-qwen38-strata-ab.py --candidate strata-nvfp4-0.2.15-nvfp4.7 --candidate-only, one arm at a time on 127.0.0.1:1921 (not reachable from the LAN), production launcher config, nothing else on the 5090, 1919 stopped; one trial per case. Arms differ only in the drafter. The DFlash2 arm needed a header-reader fix in the staged strata_control/drafting.py (docs/drafts/strata-nvfp4-gguf-facts-string-array.md); the other arms do not depend on it. Arm B ran twice (the second time as an arm C whose tuned-layer variable reached only the engine), which gives the run-to-run spread. Pass rule set beforehand: the fastest arm on Chinese/English chat decode, with every check passing; a gap under 3% goes to the simpler arm (A, B, C, D).
verdict: The upgrade alone (arm A) is +14-25% on decode and +30% on the 128K prompt against the 2026-11-12 record. C is fastest on both chat probes (Chinese +3.7% over B, beyond B's 0.4% repeat spread; English +0.8%) and accepts 77% of drafts against 73%. DFlash2 is the slowest, below the plain MTP (Chinese 170 against 203). Every arm passes every check.

D_dflash2.drafter: --draft dflash2 (stock pinned pack, Q4_0 selector) --mtp-draft-vocab mtp/rt/draft_vocab.bin --spec 6 --draft-conf 0.5
